title: Interviewing a Florida bishop who was Jack Martin's friend
summary: Peter Levenda tells of Interviewing a Florida bishop who was Jack Martin's friend, about 1970s; interview later at Florida, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Years later, I'm interviewing a bishop in Florida who was uh a friend of Jack Martin.

plain: An author named Peter Levenda says that years after first hearing about a man named Jack Martin, he interviewed a bishop in Florida who had been Martin's friend. He mentions photographs of Martin dressed as a priest. Levenda told this to a podcast host, Jesse Michels, as part of a wider story about hidden figures behind major events.
